info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Webhook Subscription Management API
info.description: The Webhook Subscription Management API enables businesses to manage their notification subscriptions via webhooks. By utilizing this endpoint, users can seamlessly create subscriptions to receive real-time updates and notifications about important events. This functionality is particularly useful for developers integrating external services, ensuring timely data delivery. Typical consumers include application developers and system integrators looking to enhance their systems with automated notifications.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new webhook. You can configure it to listen for specific events and receive notifications when those events occur.

requestBody.description: This request body requires a JSON object that specifies the details for the webhook operation. The included fields must match the defined schema to ensure proper processing of the webhook.

201.description: Webhook created successfully, and the request was processed without issues.

url.description: The URL where the webhook will send its notifications.

events.description: A list of events that the webhook will subscribe to.
